findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Narrow the Production exposure claim: the prefetched evidence is best-effort and can be empty. Either measure one Opus 5.5 call with the acceptance criterion but no evidence block, or state that this production shape is still unmeasured and file a follow-up.
evidence: Plan: "production completion-verifier and plan-review prompts always carry the ticket's acceptance criteria and gathered evidence — the shape that measured 0 filtered."

src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_prefetch.py:359-408: assemble_prefetch returns `"", []` when the ticket read fails or when no file bodies or diffs are readable ('An empty result ... yields an empty section string so the caller appends nothing').
completion_prefetch.py:3-4 module docstring: the verifier 'used to receive only a fenced ticket_context (description + comments) with ZERO file contents', and the prefetch is 'fail-open'.
Plan measurement: the only 0/N case is 'prepending a concrete acceptance criterion plus test/source evidence'. An acceptance criterion alone was never measured.
findings.finding: The Production exposure claim says production completion-verifier prompts 'always carry the ticket's acceptance criteria and gathered evidence', and that this is 'the shape that measured 0 filtered'. The code does not support 'always ... gathered evidence'. The completion verifier's evidence block is a best-effort prefetch that can come back empty: no readable file_impact paths and no referencing commits give an empty section, and a ticket read failure gives `"", []`. The plan also never measured an acceptance criterion without evidence. Every 0/N case added the criterion and the evidence together. So the argument that production is not exposed, which is why the plan changes no runtime code, rests on more than was shown.
scenarios: A ticket with no file_impact and no referencing commits (for example a [non-codebase] or doc-only ticket) reaches the production completion verifier on Opus 5.5 with acceptance criteria but no prefetched evidence. If the filter is triggered by missing evidence rather than missing criteria, that call could also come back content_filtered.
findings.suggested_fix: Change 'always carry the ticket's acceptance criteria and gathered evidence' to 'always carry the ticket's acceptance criteria (description), plus best-effort prefetched evidence that can be empty (completion_prefetch.assemble_prefetch)'. Then add one measurement to the Root cause list: criterion text with no evidence block, using the production system prompt.

evidence: 2 criterion line(s) bundle multiple deliverables with 'and' (split so each is independently verifiable).

findings.finding: The production-exposure conclusion is not supported by the evidence offered. The plan's measurements identify the trigger as a verifier being asked for a verdict with no criterion or evidence. A bare 'You are a completion verifier.' system prompt was filtered 7/8. Yet the only production check is a `git grep` for the exact string 'You are a completion verifier that emits a single structured verdict.' The claim that production verifier and plan-review prompts 'always carry' acceptance criteria and evidence is asserted without naming the code path that guarantees it. Uncovered cases include a ticket with no ACs, an empty evidence-gathering result, and a plan-review call on a sparse ticket. Changing only the test could therefore turn the CI arm green while a real production filter path stays untested.
scenarios: A ticket with an empty or missing acceptance-criteria list reaches the production completion verifier on Bedrock Opus 5.5. The request is content_filtered and surfaces LLMInputRejectedError in production, while the now-green harness no longer exercises that shape.
Evidence gathering returns nothing (no tests or sources found), and the verifier prompt reduces to a verdict request with nothing to verify.
findings.suggested_fix: In the Production exposure paragraph, cite the `src` functions that assemble completion-verifier and plan-review prompts. State the guard (or its absence) that keeps them from sending an empty criterion or evidence block. If no guard exists, file a follow-up to handle empty-AC / empty-evidence verification explicitly, and reference it from this ticket.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Make the harness robust to a stray filtered refusal: in the matrix loop, catch LLMInputRejectedError per reply and record it as a counted `filtered` outcome in the artifacts and score_table.json, so one stochastic refusal doesn't abort the run (keeping the evidence-bearing prompts as the main fix). Or justify, with a larger sample, that the per-call rate is low enough for 40 calls a run.
evidence: tests/external/test_structured_output_matrix.py:154-162 runs 2 variants × 2 prompts × _N_REPEATS=10 = 40 _live_reply calls per cell, with no try/except around runner.run (line 115)
Plan: 'Opus 5.5 declines that request stochastically'
Plan: 'rewritten evidence prompts in both directive variants: 0/40'
Plan Testing: 'rerun the probe ... before pushing (expected 0 filtered)', which is one more small sample, not a bound on the rate
findings.finding: The mechanism depends on Opus 5.5 never filtering any of the 40 live calls the job makes per run, but the evidence only shows 0 filtered out of about 40-60 samples. Even one filtered call still raises LLMInputRejectedError out of _live_reply and fails the whole job, because nothing in the harness catches it. A zero-in-40 result is consistent with a true per-call filter rate of a few percent. At a 2-5% rate, a 40-call run would fail about 55-87% of the time, and the plan names no fallback if the 2026-11-15 run trips the filter even once.
findings.location: Approach / Scope: tests/external/test_structured_output_matrix.py (_live_reply and the variant×prompt×repeat loop)
scenarios: The scheduled Sunday run hits a single content_filtered reply in 40 calls and the external LLM (live bedrock) job goes red again, failing the ticket's live-run AC

Each Bedrock CI run makes about 40 calls, and the harness has no handling for LLMInputRejectedError, so one stochastic filter aborts the whole sweep and fails the job.
